bullets.text: Cellnex Delivers for VodafoneThree - **Cellnex** has completed its first consolidated site for **VodafoneThree**, enhancing 4G and 5G coverage.
Verizon Plans Major Layoffs - **Verizon** is set to cut 15,000 jobs as part of a restructuring to improve efficiency.
Nokia Expands Data Center Portfolio - **Nokia** introduces new switches to support AI workloads and enhance data center performance.
Private 5G Meets Generative AI - The convergence of **private 5G** and **generative AI** is driving innovation in industrial connectivity.
Amazon Leo Competes with Starlink - **Amazon** rebrands its satellite initiative as **Amazon Leo**, gearing up for competition with **SpaceX**.
Viasat Launches Next-Gen Satellite - **Viasat**'s new satellite enhances capacity and introduces real-time data relay capabilities.
Telefónica Deutschland Changes Leadership - **Telefónica Deutschland** appoints Santiago Argelich Hesse as CEO amid strategic transformation.
Altnets Thrive in UK Market - Predictions of consolidation among UK altnets have not materialized, with continued investment and competition.
Vodacom Partners with Starlink - **Vodacom** collaborates with **Starlink** to enhance mobile backhaul services across Africa.
ESA Trials 5G with Satellite Links - The **ESA** successfully tests integrating satellite links into 5G networks for enhanced connectivity.
